evidence.reason: The three `ledgerScope` calls materialize caller-controlled requested, input, and reviewed scopes. Since `ledgerScope` expands intervals into retained per-line sets (the maps are later consumed by the line-set `isSubset` checks), the per-row interval validation does not bound the aggregate allocation. A compact payload with many paths, each spanning a large interval, can therefore allocate hundreds of millions of `Set` entries and exhaust the heap during validation. No current contract clause accepts this limitation; bounding the aggregate or using compact interval containment is a routine validation fix.
